scope: Visible attributes and parts for incremental grounded learning. A definition is not evidence of learned recognition.

observation_policy.generic_knowledge: Species descriptions and typical anatomy are separate from what is visible in a particular image.
observation_policy.hidden_parts: Not visible means UNKNOWN, not absent and not inferred from the class name.
observation_policy.identity: Colors, patterns and parts are evidence, not sufficient hard rules for object identity.
observation_policy.giraffe: Neck, torso, head, muzzle, visible legs, ears, tail, coat patches and ossicones require per-image localization and visibility annotation.
observation_policy.watermelon: Whole fruit and cut fruit need separate observations. Green color, oval contour and stripes are not individually mandatory.
observation_policy.completeness: Describe every supported visible attribute and explicitly mark uncertainty; never promise all properties of an object from one image.
